// Reprint of input file "grammar.y".
// Symbols:
//   0 $            3 PLUS         6 EQ           9 UNUSED      12 error     
//   1 ID           4 MINUS        7 ANY         10 expr      
//   2 NUMBER       5 STAR         8 KW          11 start     
expr ::= expr PLUS|MINUS expr.
expr ::= ID|NUMBER.
expr ::=.
start ::= expr.
expr ::= expr STAR expr.
expr ::= MINUS expr. [STAR]
expr ::= error.
